title: invalidate
description: Event: tag invalidation outcome across the local pool and the CDN purger (cdn: "purged" = a real purger ran without error; "failed" = the purge threw; "skipped" = the bound purger is NullPurger, no CDN configured). Pre-write cleanup vs real invalidation is recorded at the source, not inferred: an invalidate is pre-write cleanup iff the event immediately preceding it in the same scope's event stream is a pre_write_cleanup marker, emitted by the writer (QueryRepository::doPut(), DonutRepository::putStatic()/putDonut()) right before it clears the entry it replaces. Any invalidate without the marker is a real invalidation. A write into an empty slot replaces nothing and records neither event: a cache miss, or the re-put of a #[Refresh] command, whose purge emptied the slot first. Note the pre-write cleanup uses the resource's own URI tag, which its other X_VARY variants carry and which is also its parents' surrogate key, so replacing an entry visibly drops those entries too — visible by design.

roPool.description: Outcome of invalidating the tags in the Resource Object pool

cdn.description: Outcome of the CDN surrogate-key purge: "purged" = a configured purger ran without error; "failed" = the purge threw (fail-closed: the exception surfaces after the local pool was invalidated, so a "failed" outcome always accompanies a thrown exception); "skipped" = the bound purger is NullPurger, i.e. no CDN is configured and nothing was purged by design

durationMs.description: Wall-clock duration of the invalidation in milliseconds
